display.purpose: What is sounding, in the band. Steps down to 34, 27 and 21px as it has more to say.

headline.purpose: Section headings on Measurements and Notes.

prose.purpose: The long read on Notes, held to the 33rem measure.

label.purpose: A control's name: an instrument, a knob, a pedal. Never under 12px.

label-strong.purpose: The words inside the view switch and the picker pill.

plotted.purpose: The vector style's lettering: Hershey Simplex, single-stroke capitals. Used only there.

shadows.name: shadow-1
shadows.purpose: Resting: a small paper control on the wall (octave buttons, the picker pill).

shadows.name: shadow-3
shadows.purpose: Lifted: a menu or the phone sheet, open over the stage.

shadows.name: fallboard-shade
shadows.purpose: The fallboard's lower edge throwing a little shade on the keys.

shadows.name: stage-knob
shadows.purpose: A stage knob's paper disc standing off the instrument (a filter, not a box-shadow).

shadows.name: key-white
shadows.purpose: A white key's lip and its shadow.

shadows.name: key-black
shadows.purpose: A black key's lip and its shadow on the whites.

shadows.name: floor-shadow-2d
shadows.value: rgba(28, 34, 42, 0.32), blur 20-26px, offset about (7px, 12px) for a body the size of a cello
shadows.purpose: A drawn instrument's one soft shadow on the floor (stage-draw.ts floorShadow), cached, never blurred per frame.

shadows.name: room-patch-2d
shadows.purpose: The room as light: the floor's brighter patch under one instrument in 2D (.stage[data-room]::before), sized by the room's knob.

shadows.name: day-3d
shadows.value: key 2.2, rim 0.25, fill 0.7, env 1.2, exposure 1.06, shadow depth 0.62
shadows.purpose: The 3D studio daylight (three3d.ts DAY): a generated room of plaster, a skylight, a north window of panes and two black cards.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: The one easing for state changes (--ease).

motion.name: state
motion.purpose: Default colour, background and border transitions on controls.

motion.name: state-quick
motion.purpose: The player's buttons and an ensemble part going blue.

motion.name: readout-dim
motion.purpose: The readout dimming to 0.36 when nothing sounds.

motion.name: pedal-travel
motion.purpose: A pedal or an octave button going down.

motion.name: lamp-pulse
motion.purpose: The lamp while the sound is starting; the only looping animation in the chrome.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Motion that is not the instrument's own is removed; every state still changes, at once.

breakpoints.name: bar-tight
breakpoints.purpose: The bar's gaps draw in so the lamp's hint stays on one line.

breakpoints.name: picker-fold
breakpoints.purpose: The sixteen instruments fold to one pill that opens a sheet, four to a row.

breakpoints.name: phone
breakpoints.purpose: The phone layout: a 48px bar, the keys under a position strip.

breakpoints.name: narrow
breakpoints.purpose: The pages and the close-up tighten.

breakpoints.name: small-phone
breakpoints.purpose: The player's menus and the 404 page tighten.

breakpoints.name: narrowest
breakpoints.purpose: The narrowest phones: the fallboard still fits.

breakpoints.name: landscape-phone
breakpoints.purpose: A phone held sideways: one slim band; the picker folds here too.

breakpoints.name: touch
breakpoints.purpose: Targets grow to a finger's size (36px player buttons, 44px stage knobs).

components.name: Player pill and play disc
components.description: The file player: a paper pill on the stage. Play is the one solid thing on it, an ink disc; the hairline fills in blue with the place in the piece.
components.css: .ds-player { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 3px 12px 3px 5px; border: 1px solid var(--rule); border-radius: 20px; background: var(--paper); box-shadow: var(--shadow-2); } .ds-pl-btn { flex: none; width: 30px; height: 30px; padding: 6px; border: 0; border-radius: 50%; background: none; color: var(--ink-2); cursor: pointer; transition: color 0.12s var(--ease), background-color 0.12s var(--ease); } .ds-pl-btn:hover { color: var(--ink); background: var(--ground-2); } .ds-pl-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ink); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-pl-btn svg { display: block; width: 100%; height: 100%; fill: currentColor; } .ds-pl-play { background: var(--ink); color: var(--paper); padding: 7px; } .ds-pl-play:hover { background: #000; color: #fff; } .ds-pl-play:active { transform: scale(0.94); } .ds-pl-bar { position: relative; width: 160px; height: 2px; border-radius: 1px; background: var(--rule-2); } .ds-pl-fill { position: absolute; inset: 0; border-radius: 1px; background: var(--accent); transform-origin: left; transform: scaleX(0.38); }

components.name: View switch
components.description: One choice of three (2d, vector, 3d); the chosen one is an ink pill. The piano kind (grand, upright) is the same control.
components.css: .ds-view-seg { display: inline-flex; padding: 2px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--ground-2); } .ds-view-seg button { border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: none; padding: 5px 11px 6px; font: 550 12.5px/1.15 var(--font); font-variant-numeric: lining-nums; color: var(--ink-2); cursor: pointer; transition: color 0.15s var(--ease), background-color 0.15s var(--ease); } .ds-view-seg button:hover { color: var(--ink); } .ds-view-seg button[aria-pressed="true"] { color: var(--paper); background: var(--ink); } .ds-view-seg button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ink); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Instrument pick
components.description: An instrument in the bar: a drawn glyph over its name. Chosen is ink with a 1.5px ink rule under the name.
components.css: .ds-picks { display: flex; } .ds-pick { position: relative; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; min-width: 40px; padding: 3px 3px 6px; border: 0; border-radius: 9px; background: none; color: var(--muted); cursor: pointer; transition: color 0.15s var(--ease), background-color 0.15s var(--ease); } .ds-pick:hover { color: var(--ink); background: var(--ground-2); } .ds-pick[aria-pressed="true"] { color: var(--ink); } .ds-pick[aria-pressed="true"]::after { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 10px; right: 10px; bottom: 1px; height: 1.5px; border-radius: 1px; background: var(--ink); } .ds-pick:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ink); outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-glyph { width: 30px; height: 30px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.15; stroke-linejoin: round; stroke-linecap: round; overflow: visible; } .ds-g-body { fill: var(--paper); } .ds-pick-name { font: 500 12px/1.25 var(--font); white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Orchestra pill
components.description: The Orchestra is a mode, not a seventeenth instrument: an outlined pill with its drawn sign and its word; on, it is ink.
components.css: .ds-ens { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; height: 34px; padding: 0 13px 0 9px; border: 1px solid var(--rule-2); border-radius: 999px; background: none; color: var(--ink-2); font: 500 12px/1.25 var(--font); cursor: pointer; transition: color 0.15s var(--ease), background-color 0.15s var(--ease), border-color 0.15s var(--ease); } .ds-ens:hover { color: var(--ink); border-color: var(--ink-2); } .ds-ens[aria-pressed="true"] { color: var(--paper); background: var(--ink); border-color: var(--ink); } .ds-ens:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ink); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-ens-icon { width: 20px; height: 20px; } .ds-ens-icon circle { fill: currentColor; }

components.name: Rotary knob
components.description: A pale dial on the fallboard: its setting is an arc of ink and a pointer on the cap; its reading stands over it while it is under the hand.
components.css: .ds-knob { position: relative; display: inline-flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; width: 58px; margin-top: 26px; cursor: ns-resize; user-select: none; outline: none; } .ds-k-face { width: 38px; height: 38px; overflow: visible; display: block; } .ds-k-track { fill: none; stroke: var(--rule); stroke-width: 2; stroke-linecap: round; } .ds-k-val { fill: none; stroke: var(--ink); stroke-width: 2; stroke-linecap: round; } .ds-k-cap { fill: #fff; stroke: var(--rule-2); stroke-width: 0.7; filter: drop-shadow(0.4px 1px 1px rgba(28, 34, 42, 0.26)); transition: stroke 0.15s var(--ease); } .ds-k-ptr { stroke: var(--ink); stroke-width: 1.7; stroke-linecap: round; } .ds-knob:hover .ds-k-cap { stroke: var(--ink-2); } .ds-knob:focus-visible .ds-k-cap { stroke: var(--ink); stroke-width: 1.4; } .ds-k-name { font: 500 12px/1.25 var(--font); color: var(--muted); white-space: nowrap; } .ds-knob:hover .ds-k-name, .ds-knob:focus-visible .ds-k-name { color: var(--ink); } .ds-k-read { position: absolute; left: 50%; bottom: calc(100% + 3px); transform: translateX(-50%); display: none; padding: 2px 7px; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--ink); color: var(--paper); font: 500 12px/1.35 var(--font); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums lining-nums; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-knob:hover .ds-k-read, .ds-knob:focus-visible .ds-k-read { display: block; }

components.name: Stage knob
components.description: The room and lid knobs on the stage: the same dial on a paper disc that stands off the instrument by its shadow. No word; a drawn sign on the cap says which it is.
components.css: .ds-stage-knob { display: inline-block; width: 38px; height: 38px; border-radius: 50%; cursor: ns-resize; filter: drop-shadow(1px 2px 3px rgba(28, 34, 42, 0.26)); } .ds-stage-knob:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ink); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-k-face { width: 38px; height: 38px; overflow: visible; display: block; } .ds-k-track { fill: none; stroke: var(--rule); stroke-width: 2; stroke-linecap: round; } .ds-k-val { fill: none; stroke: var(--ink); stroke-width: 2; stroke-linecap: round; } .ds-k-cap { fill: #fff; stroke: var(--rule-2); stroke-width: 0.7; transition: stroke 0.15s var(--ease); } .ds-k-ptr { stroke: var(--ink); stroke-width: 1.7; stroke-linecap: round; } .ds-sk-bg { fill: var(--paper); stroke: var(--rule-2); stroke-width: 0.8; transition: stroke 0.15s var(--ease); } .ds-sk-sign { fill: none; stroke: var(--muted); stroke-width: 1.1; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-stage-knob:hover .ds-sk-bg, .ds-stage-knob:focus-visible .ds-sk-bg, .ds-stage-knob:hover .ds-sk-sign, .ds-stage-knob:focus-visible .ds-sk-sign { stroke: var(--ink); }

components.name: Piano keys
components.description: Ivory and ebony, lit from the left. A key pressed goes down and stays its own colour; a key whose note sounds takes the blue (the second white key and the second black key here).
components.css: .ds-keys { position: relative; width: 144px; height: 130px; } .ds-key { position: absolute; top: 0; cursor: pointer; } .ds-white { width: 36px; height: 100%; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #e3e1d9 0%, var(--ivory) 7%, #fcfbf7 80%, #edece5 100%); border-left: 1px solid #b3b0a6; border-right: 1px solid #fff; border-radius: 0 0 5px 5px; box-shadow: inset 0 -5px 0 #dcdad2, 0.5px 2px 2px rgba(28, 34, 42, 0.22); z-index: 1; transition: transform 0.04s, box-shadow 0.04s; } .ds-black { width: 22px; height: 62%; background: linear-gradient(90deg, #4a5057 0 1px, rgba(74, 80, 87, 0) 1px calc(100% - 1px), #0e1013 calc(100% - 1px)), linear-gradient(180deg, #17191c 0%, #2c3035 70%, #3b4046 92%, #1d2023 100%); border-radius: 0 0 3px 3px; box-shadow: inset 0 -6px 0 #14161a, 1px 3px 4px rgba(28, 34, 42, 0.4); z-index: 2; transition: transform 0.04s, box-shadow 0.04s; } .ds-white:active { transform: translateY(2px); box-shadow: inset 0 -2px 0 #dcdad2, 0 0 0 rgba(28, 34, 42, 0); background: linear-gradient(180deg, #d6d4cc 0%, #f0efe8 12%, #f4f3ec 100%); } .ds-black:active { transform: translateY(2px); box-shadow: inset 0 -2px 0 #14161a, 0.5px 1px 2px rgba(28, 34, 42, 0.4); } .ds-white.ds-sounding { background: linear-gradient(180deg, #bccdf6 0%, var(--accent-wash) 14%, #e6edff 100%); border-left-color: #9fb3e6; box-shadow: inset 0 -2px 0 #b7c8f2, 0 0 0 rgba(28, 34, 42, 0); } .ds-black.ds-sounding { background: linear-gradient(90deg, #5f85f0 0 1px, rgba(95, 133, 240, 0) 1px calc(100% - 1px), #12308f calc(100% - 1px)), linear-gradient(180deg, #1637a8 0%, #2553e0 72%, #3a66ea 92%, #1a3fb8 100%); box-shadow: inset 0 -2px 0 #12308f, 0.5px 1px 2px rgba(28, 34, 42, 0.4); }

components.name: Readout
components.description: Everything that is sounding, light and large, with one line under it. It keeps its 260 by 60px box and dims when nothing sounds.
components.html:
C4 E4 G4
C major
components.css: .ds-readout { width: 260px; height: 60px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; transition: opacity 0.3s var(--ease); } .ds-r-note { height: 40px; font: 300 40px/40px var(--font); letter-spacing: -0.005em; color: var(--ink); white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; } .ds-r-hz { height: 16px; margin-top: 4px; font: 500 12.5px/16px var(--font); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums lining-nums; color: var(--ink-2); white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Tooltip
components.description: The name of an icon-only control: paper text on an ink label, as small as it can be read.
components.css: .ds-tip { display: inline-block; padding: 3px 8px 4px; border-radius: 7px; font: 500 12.5px/1.3 var(--font); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums lining-nums; color: var(--paper); background: var(--ink); white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Pedal
components.description: A drawn foot with its name under it. Held, it goes down and takes ink (press it here).
components.css: .ds-pedal { display: inline-flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 1px; width: 48px; padding: 3px 0 0; border: 0; background: none; color: var(--muted); cursor: pointer; user-select: none; } .ds-p-face { width: 30px; height: 28px; transition: transform 0.06s; filter: drop-shadow(0.5px 1.5px 1.5px rgba(28, 34, 42, 0.22)); } .ds-p-foot { fill: var(--paper); stroke: var(--ink-2); stroke-width: 1.1; } .ds-p-shine { fill: none; stroke: var(--rule-2); stroke-width: 1; } .ds-pedal:hover .ds-p-foot { stroke: var(--ink); } .ds-pedal:active .ds-p-face { transform: translateY(3px) scaleY(0.9); filter: drop-shadow(0.5px 0.5px 1.5px rgba(28, 34, 42, 0.22)); } .ds-pedal:active .ds-p-foot { fill: var(--ink); stroke: var(--ink); } .ds-pedal:active .ds-p-shine { stroke: rgba(249, 250, 251, 0.4); } .ds-pedal:active .ds-p-name { color: var(--ink); } .ds-pedal:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ink); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-p-name { font: 500 12px/1.25 var(--font); }

narrative.overview:
A north-lit white studio at midday. The instrument stands in it, and the page is the same plaster as the wall. The brief that pins it: a bright, minimal daylight studio; high-key, pale ground, soft north light; the feeling of a quiet photography studio or a modern practice room at midday. Air, space and clarity.

The mood is quiet, bright, exact and unhurried. The instrument is the largest thing on the screen by far. Everything round it is small, pale, round and drawn: discs, pills and hairlines set straight on the wall, with no panel behind them. Daylight has no glows, so state has only two forms. Ink is what is chosen or held. Blue is what sounds.

It rejects two looks. One is the incumbent night bench: a near-black ground, amber glows, a serif readout. The other is the generic SaaS light theme: cards, borders round regions, a tinted accent on every control.

The same room is shown three ways and they keep one grammar. The drawn 2D stage is an opaque object in its daylight materials on the bright field. The vector style is a drawing in graphite on a sheet of drafting film. The 3D stage is a generated daylight room.
keyCharacteristics: One plaster white for wall, floor and page; paper white for what is laid on it.
Light from the upper left; every shadow falls down and a little right, and is soft.
Two forms of state: ink for chosen or held, one ultramarine for what sounds.
One sans, light and large for the readout, medium and small for labels.
The stage is nearly wordless; icon-only controls carry a tooltip.

rules.name: The One Plaster Rule
rules.body: One white (`ground`) is the wall, the floor and the page. No panel stands behind the bar or the band. What is laid on the ground is paper white and casts a soft shadow down and to the right (the window is up and to the left).

rules.name: The Two Forms of State Rule
rules.body: Ink is what is chosen or held: the instrument on the stage, the view, a knob's setting, a key pressed, a valve down. Blue is what sounds: a string's shape, a key sounding, a part playing, the place in a piece, a wavefront, a plate's motion. Nothing else is blue.

rules.name: The Leads Are a Key Rule
rules.body: The vector style's green, red, pink and deep leads tie a knob to the part of the drawing it moves. They are a key, not an accent: never on chrome outside the vector style.

rules.name: The One Face Rule
rules.body: Ysabeau Office sets the page. Sometype Mono is for code and equations only. Hershey Simplex is the vector style's lettering, a third face used only there and on purpose. A canvas letters in `CANVAS_FONT` (`ui/stage-draw.ts`), never in a face named in a string.

rules.name: The Twelve Pixel Rule
rules.body: A control's name is never under 12px. Smaller figures exist only as counts and legends beside a sign (a seat count, a key's computer-key letter), never as the name of a control.

rules.name: The Nothing Glows Rule
rules.body: No additive compositing, no coloured halo, in CSS, on a canvas or in 3D. Where a glow once said "this is active", ink or blue says it. A struck bar or drumhead in 3D takes a faint cast of the blue while it rings (`ui/gl/ring-glow.ts`): a cast on the material, not a lamp.

rules.name: The One Window Rule
rules.body: Light comes from the upper left. A shadow that falls any other way, or straight down, is wrong.

rules.name: The Drawn Signs Rule
rules.body: Icons and control marks are drawn SVG or CSS shapes (`ui/icons.ts`, `ui/controls.ts`, `ui/stage-knob.ts`), never a character of a font. Lines are 1.1 to 1.5px in the current colour with round caps and joins; an instrument's glyph has its body filled paper.

dos: Do keep one plaster white (`ground`) as wall, floor and page, and set the bar and the band straight on it.
Do lay anything that floats (the player, a menu, a sheet, a stage knob) on paper white with one of the three shadows, falling down and to the right.
Do mark what is chosen or held in ink: a filled ink pill, a 1.5px ink rule, an ink arc, an ink outline.
Do keep the blue for what sounds, and use it firmly where it is used.
Do draw every sign as SVG or a CSS shape (`ui/icons.ts`, `ui/controls.ts`, `ui/stage-knob.ts`) and give an icon-only control a tooltip and an `aria-label`.
Do set control names at 12px or more, weight 500, and figures that change in tabular numerals.
Do paint a drawn object's floor shadow once, into its cached layer.
Do give pale materials (silver, ivory, a drumhead, bow hair) a graphite hairline or a shade side so they stand off the pale ground.
donts: Don't bring back the night bench: a near-black ground, amber glows, a serif readout.
Don't build a generic SaaS light theme: cards, borders round regions, a tinted accent on every control.
Don't put a panel, a fill or a rule behind the bar or the band.
Don't use blue for a mechanical state (a key held, a valve down, a view chosen), for decoration, or for a link.
Don't make anything glow: no additive compositing (`'lighter'`, `'screen'`), no coloured `shadowBlur` halo, no bloom, in CSS, on a canvas or in 3D.
Don't use a character of a font as an icon or a control mark.
Don't use the vector style's leads (green, red, pink, deep) on chrome outside the vector style.
Don't use the Alarm colour for anything but a fault.
Don't use Sometype Mono outside code and equations, or Hershey outside the vector style.
Don't add permanent explanatory words to the stage.
